mechanism.conjecture: Recent trading concentrated just above the current completed close may leave nearby offers when price revisits those transaction levels. Test SHORT the largest nearby overhead traded-notional share. This is a falsifiable price-volume resistance conjecture, not observed crypto profitability or proof of investor cost bases, ownership, orders or supply.
mechanism.distinct_variable: A price-local weighted empirical distribution: quote volume assigned by the price level of each historical completed bar. Neither unsigned activity growth, temporal volume HHI, signed OBV/MFI flow, a moving-average crossover, return rank nor a BTC lag/beta estimate is the score.
material_risks: An hourly typical price assigns an entire hour's quote volume to one proxy price; it is not an actual volume-at-price histogram or holder cost basis.
High overhead concentration may instead precede positive breakout continuation; the conjectured SHORT direction can be wrong.
The score can correlate with momentum, current price location and other price-volume families. No independent-alpha or global-novelty claim.
No evidence yet establishes gross expectancy above realistic 14bp base or 30bp stress round trip plus impact and funding.
mechanism.external_empirical_result_exposure_for_t: NONE_ADDED; mechanism is an unverified conjecture, not calibrated from an external reported return.
